description: The frame of a board: columns side by side, as wide as the room allows and never narrower than one column's minimum, scrolling sideways when they no longer fit. The frame is one tab stop carrying a group role and a name, which is what a scrolling region needs to be reachable by keyboard at all. ArenaBoard draws no card and moves nothing. What a column holds is the consumer's, and reordering is theirs too.

label.description: Names the board to assistive technology: what the columns are columns OF. "Sprint 32 tasks by status", never "Board". Required and guarded at runtime after trimming, the shape ArenaScroller.label carries for the same reason, since a group announced as a group tells a reader that focus moved and nothing about where it landed.

content.description: The columns, one ArenaBoardColumn each. Required and guarded at runtime: a board with no columns is a tab stop over nothing, which is the dead stop a component with a group role must not ship.
